text: ②すばやい　ポケモンが　でていれば　にげやすく　なるでしょう。

structure.jp: ②すばやい　ポケモンが　でていれば
structure.en: ② if a fast Pokémon is out

structure.jp: にげやすく　なるでしょう。
structure.en: it will probably get easier to run

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.explanation: やすい added to a verb stem means 'easy to do'. にげやすい = 'easy to run away'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: An い-word changed to く before なる means 'become that way'. にげやすく　なる = 'it becomes easier to run'.

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: The ば ending on a verb means 'if'. でていれば = 'if it is out'.
